body.statement: At the optimal dosage, the exact maximum whitened leverage is \[\mu^\star=\sum_{j=0}^{k}\binom pj\left(\frac{1-u}{u}\right)^j.\]
body.justification: The leverage is the exact concentration scale of the whitened empirical Gram matrix.
body.gap: Generic bounded-design analyses use dimension-dependent envelopes and do not compute this supply-sensitive Boolean leverage.
body.consumer: The expression gives an explicit sample-size diagnostic before running a sparse-supply interaction experiment.
